availability.note: Deepal AU has no Build & Price configurator; the official E07 page (2026-11-27) lists two grades, E07 RWD and E07 AWD Performance, each with a postcode price selector (MLP/RDP) and 'Test drives are available now', no stop-sale notice. March 2026 ADR 34/03 stop-sale (missing centre-rear top tether, 218 MY25 cars recalled, CarExpert 12 Mar 2026) treated as lifted: CarExpert 7 Jul 2026 'Deliveries have subsequently resumed'; CarsGuide 19 Mar 2026 review notes top tethers expanded from two to three to meet ADRs and the AU spec sheet lists 'Child Seat Anchor Points (x3)'; CarExpert sales database shows 354 sold in 2026 YTD to October vs 215 to end-June. CarsGuide 23 Oct 2026: sales continue and orders honoured through the Inchcape-to-Changan transition (21 Oct 2026 - 31 Mar 2027).

listPrice.note: CarsGuide 23 Oct 2026 (Changan distribution story): E07 RWD $64,900 'before on-road costs', the launch list price, unchanged. Same figure in CarsGuide's 19 Mar 2026 RWD review ('plus on-road costs'), CarExpert review (9 Sep 2025) and Zecar ('RRP before on-road costs'). Deepal's own MLP is behind a postcode pricing API not reachable in this run; the E07 page shows MLP/RDP placeholders only. No E07 campaign found on deepal.com.au/special-offers (S07 only).

batteryKwh.note: Zecar: '93.6 kWh NMC (90 kWh usable)'. Deepal AU spec sheet v1.2 'Battery Capacity 89.98 kWh' (unlabelled) matches the usable figure, not the 93.6 gross; Chasing Cars also calls it the 90kWh battery. No manufacturer page states both figures.

rangeKm.note: Deepal AU spec sheet v1.2 'Estimated WLTP Driving Range' 550 km, footnote names WLTP; single wheel 265/45R21 on both grades. No UK/EU market for the E07 to cross-check; implied consumption (16.4 kWh/100km) is WLTP-plausible, not CLTC/NEDC-absurd, and reviewers observed 15-18 kWh/100km.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 90/550x100. Zecar lists WLTP combined 164 Wh/km (likely also derived). CarsGuide quotes a claimed 17.7 kWh/100km for the RWD (probably grid-to-wheel incl. charging losses), not used.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: AU spec sheet 'Trunk 524' L; frunk 131 L excluded. Deepal web page calls it '524L in the back (enclosed)'; CarsGuide: with glass dome closed and rear bulkhead upright. The E07 has no cargo cover (the enclosed bay runs up to the glass dome), so this is effectively to-the-roof; no to-cover figure exists.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: AU spec sheet 'Trunk with Seat Folded Down 1654' L; method not stated, likely to the dome/roof.

towKg.note: AU spec sheet Maximum Braked Towing Capacity 1500 kg (unbraked 750)

warrantyYears.note: '7 Year/160,000 km (whichever comes first) Manufacturer's New Vehicle Warranty', no servicing condition stated; HV battery 8 yr/240,000 km

insuranceAnnual.note: anchored to zeekr-7x-long-range-rwd 2,400 ($63,900, new Chinese brand) and deepal-s07-rwd 2,000 ($45k); nudged up for a large, complex body (motorised dome/tailgate, glass roof) and thin Deepal repair network.

depreciationCurve.note: Deepal brand curve taken from deepal-s07 (one curve per brand, owner convention). Evidence class also fits the E07: new brand, thin volume (548 sold all-time), early-2026 stop-sale/recall, distributor change to Changan, no resale history.
